articles.summary: PLANO, Texas --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jun. 10, 2026-- Diodes Incorporated (Diodes) (Nasdaq: DIOD) today expands its innovative load switch portfolio with the introduction of DML1012ALDSQ, an automotive-compliant* low drain-source on-resistance (R DS(ON)) N-channel MOSFET smart load switch.
articles.title: Smart Load Switch from Diodes Incorporated Delivers Low RDS(ON) for Automotive ADAS, Infotainment, and Display Cluster Power Rail Control
